analysis: Ordinary address-bounded LLVM inspection corroborated by historical ERM/CasDem navigation. No original Windows execution, binary upload or new Hopper result.

observations.fact: TR:E reads inverted native bit0x10. Source zero sets that bit; a nonzero source value clears it.
The ordinary movement routine tests native bit0x10; when clear it skips the object-dispatch branch. This corrects the earlier interpretation of that bit as entrance-disable rather than activation.
Artifact encoding1000 denotes the spellbook; values above1000 encode scroll spell+1001. Slot queries preserve the empty sentinel.
Slot placement checks for the empty artifact sentinel and sets flag1 for success or occupancy failure.
The single-argument grant searches the64 backpack cells and writes the first free cell; it does not auto-equip the reward.

implementation: TR:E0 activates a tile and TR:E1 suppresses activation; numeric getters retain the original inverted source value. TR:P remains independent.

Preserve the905 native layout. terrainEncoding2 identifies corrected states; old native force/hidden lists plus the executed literal initializer prefix reconstruct the original recorded E values in one replicated update. Source variables, pending answers and quest counters are not replayed.

HE:A1 places only in an empty admitted worn slot and queries the original item encoding. HE:A2 reports total and worn counts. HE:A3 removes stable native artifact instances in backpack-first or worn-first order.

Historical HE:A grants use the backpack, handle encoded scroll spells and comparisons, and remove selected spells or all scrolls for A-1. Native transfers preserve inventory limits and update native bonuses and combination locks.
admissionLimits: Explicit slot operations currently admit source positions0..18; the original campaign instruction forms inspected use those positions. Fixed-hole backpack positions19..82 and mode4 remain unadmitted.
Artifact encodings currently admit original IDs0..143 and defined scroll spell IDs0..80. Foreign and unbound encodings fail explicitly.

The migration covers the literal executed E initializers and the native force/hidden records used by the original programs; arbitrary external scripts with unrecorded dynamic empty-cell overrides are not claimed compatible.
Native artifact bonuses are handled through the engine inventory API; this does not establish equivalence to every raw Windows artifact corruption case.
